name: Tipranavir

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for liver harm and nerve and brain harm

examples.title: Effect of Cytoreductive Chemotherapy and a CCR5 Coreceptor Antagonist on HIV-1 Eradication
Quality of Life of HIV-infected Participants Switched to Raltegravir Versus Other Antiretroviral Regimens (MK-0518-266)
examples.why: The trial was terminated early due to slow recruitment.

summary: In the United States, Tipranavir has a boxed warning, which is the strongest safety alert on a medicine's label, regarding potential harm to the liver as well as damage to nerves and the brain [3]. In addition, a small computer model estimated risk scores for the drug instead of testing on actual people [M]. This computer model placed both the liver score at 63 and the heart score at 55, ranking both in the medium risk range [M].
